chunks: From him, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Yunus, from one of our companions, from Abu Al-Jaroud, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever says at the end of the obligatory prayer: 'I entrust to Allah the Magnificent, the Majestic, my self, my family, my children, and those whose affairs concern me; and I entrust to Allah the One hoped for, the One feared, the One humbled by His Greatness, everything, my self, my family, my wealth, my children, and those whose affairs concern me,' he will be shielded by a wing from the wings of Jibra'il (peace be upon him), and will be protected in his self, his family, and his wealth.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite after the obligatory prayer for protection?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq emphasizes the concept of 'Wad'i' (entrusting) as a spiritual safeguard after obligatory prayers, linking personal security to divine majesty. The promise of being shielded by the wings of Gabriel highlights the intercessory role of archangels in Shia cosmology, reinforcing the believer's reliance on Allah's protection through angelic guardianship.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad, from Yunus, from one of our companions, from Abu Al Jaroud, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘

The one who says at the end of the Obligatory (Salāt), ‘I entrust to Allahazwj the Magnificent, myself, and my family, and my wealth, and the one whose matters are meaningful to me; and I entrust to Allahazwj, the One hoped to, the One feared to, the One broken to Hisazwj Determination, everything, myself, and my family, and my wealth, and my children, and the ones who matters are meaningful to me’, would be saved by a wing from the wings of Jibraeelas, and would be protected regarding himself, and his family, and his wealth’.
en.sarwar: 12. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from la’ far ibn Muhammad from Yunus from certain individuals of our people from abu al- Jarud from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Whoever, after an obligatory prayer, says, ‘Under the trust of Allah, the Great, the Most Glorious, I place myself, family, children and all those whose affairs concern me, under the trust of Allah, whose Greatness is awesome, frightful and unapproachable, I place myself, family, children and all those whose affairs concern me,’ he will be guarded under the wing of Jibril (Gabriel), his person, family and belongings will be protected.’”
